84:
WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS first_name, "district" FROM "schools" WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT "first_name"
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY "first_name"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 2
)

SELECT an."first_name", an."district"
FROM admin_names an
JOIN top_names tn ON an."first_name" = tn."first_name"
GROUP BY an."first_name", an."district"
ORDER BY an."first_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, an."district" ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT

    sc.county
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc
    ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE (s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrread + s.avgscrwrite) = (
    SELECT MIN(s2.avgscrmath + s2.avgscrread + s2.avgscrwrite)

WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT s."county", COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "schools" s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s."county"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT s."school", s."closeddate"
FROM "schools" s
JOIN closed_counts cc ON s."county" = cc."county"
WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
ORDER BY s."closeddate" ASC NULLS FIRST;

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT s.school, s.doctype
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
CROSS JOIN avg_diff a
WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > a.avg_difference

  AND l."status" = 'Legal'
